authorial_core.baseline_prompt_en: A naturalistic military-fiction photograph centered on a reference-guided woman taking part in a moment of military unit life. Her individual presence comes through quiet concentration and the relaxed softness of her mouth, her gaze following the braid rather than posing for the camera. Both wear olive ceremonial tunics with structured shoulders and small plain metal collar insignia. The comrade stands to her right, turned slightly toward her, with his left shoulder facing the camera and his arms resting at his sides. She stands close on both feet; her right thumb and forefinger pinch the braid beside his left epaulette while her left palm supports the hanging loop below, easing it into a smooth continuous curve across his upper chest. Her two forearms extend from separate visible sleeves into these contacts, and the cord remains visibly attached at his shoulder. He looks down patiently at the settling loop. The small act of care carries the moment: one uniform is almost ready, and the waiting formation makes its completion matter. Photograph them from just above waist height in a three-quarter, knee-up two-shot, with her face, both of her hands, his left shoulder and the entire hanging loop simultaneously legible. A 50 mm perspective keeps faces and hands proportionate. Open shade separates the olive cloth and warm braid; a low strip of morning sun catches her bob and the courtyard paving. Fine cloth texture, small creases beside the working wrist and a slight asymmetry in their stances make this feel like an observed instant before ceremony.
